description: Does Joe's own sentinel/ghost PreToolUse hook intercept enforce's probes? The hook inspects Bash tool calls; enforce's probes are subprocess calls from inside python, so they should be invisible to it. This spec fires attack-shaped argv to find out. Harmless: it reads a path that does not exist and prints a marker.

controls.name: guard-does-not-eat-probes
controls.declares: an attack-shaped probe argv reaches the target instead of being blocked by the agent's own PreToolUse hook
